items.html: *Only the Behina of the apparent Malchut is not in AA, but in its Ateret Yesod. It is so because all that is Dechura, but there is no actual Nukva. In Atik Yomin too there is no Nukva in itself, only the Ateret Yesod de Atik is Nukva, as in AA. However, afterwards, Malchut appears from that Upper most Reisha de Lo Etyada, called Atik Yomin, who is above all these nine Sefirot de AA.
